@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+class DataProcessor:
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        self.config = config
+        self._cache = {}
+
+    def process(self, data, mode):
+        if mode == "fast":
+            return self._fast_process(data)
+        return self._slow_process(data)
+
+    def _fast_process(self, data):
+        result = []
+        for item in data:
+            result.append(item * 2)
+        return result
+
+    def _slow_process(self, data):
+        import time
+        time.sleep(0.1)
+        return [item for item in data if item > 0]
+
+    def clear_cache(self):
+        self._cache = {}
